tips.title: Welcome, captain
lines: You have a small ship and a little money. Trade between
locations, make your ship better, build a fleet, and fight
or hunt pirates. The career lasts 730 days.
Top row: the day, your credits, fuel, and cargo.
Left: the sector map. Right: the panel with the keys.
Bottom: the newest log messages (L shows all of them).
The game saves each time you dock. Q, Q saves and quits.
X opens the Codex: who makes and who buys each good.
Each screen has help: press ?.

tips.title: Your first trade
lines: A good first trade near here:
Buy:    {commodity} at {buyAt}
about {buy} cr for each unit
Sell:   at {sellAt}
about {sell} cr for each unit
Profit: about {profit} cr for {units} units
Go to {buyAt}: select it on the map and press
Enter. Then open the services (O) and buy on the Market
tab. The goal line on the panel shows each step.
The Trade Ledger (T) shows more routes.
noPlanLines: The Trade Ledger (T) shows the best known routes: what to
buy, where to sell it, and the profit.
Open the services here (O). Buy on the Market tab. Then
travel to a location that pays more, and sell.

tips.title: Location services
lines: Each service of this location has a tab (1-9, or Left and
Right). Market: buy and sell. Refuel: fill the tanks.
Mechanic: repair. Insurance: Clone Insurance for your ship.
Outfitter and Shipyard: modules and hulls. Merchants' Guild
and Bounty Guild: contracts.
I shows your fleet and cargo. Esc goes back to the map.

tips.title: The Market
lines: Up and Down select a commodity.
B buys 1 unit. Shift+B buys as much as you can.
S sells 1 unit. Shift+S sells all.
Each unit that you buy makes the next one dearer. Each unit
that you sell makes the next one cheaper. The last column
shows the best known sell price at other locations.

tips.title: Cargo on board
lines: Now take the cargo to a location that pays more.
In this sector: select the location on the sector map
(a-f) and press Enter.
In another sector: M opens the region map. Select the
sector and press Enter.
Travel uses time and fuel. Refuel (R) when you dock.

tips.title: The region map
lines: The number after each sector is its security level, from
0 (Lawless) to 4 (Secure). The ! row shows the threat band
(1-5). More ! means stronger pirates.
Pirates disable your ship and take all the cargo. Other
enemies destroy it. Clone Insurance at any location gives
you your ship again after a loss.

tips.title: A profit
lines: Good work: you made {profitSold} cr on that sale.
Next steps: trade more, and buy Clone Insurance before you
go to sectors with low security. The Outfitter sells
modules, and the Shipyard sells bigger hulls.

tips.title: An encounter
lines: The hail shows the other ships and their threat band.
Fight: start a battle. Flee: try to get away (it can fail).
Pay: give pirates half the cargo of your fullest ship.
Ignore, Pursue, Attack: when the other side is not hostile.
R: fight, and the AI plays the battle for you at once.

tips.title: Your first battle
lines: Each turn: plan, then press E to end the turn.
1-0 switch modules ON or OFF. The Power line shows the
available, reserved, and maximum power.
Arrows and Enter: move. Tab: target. F: fire.
To flee, move onto a map edge with an engine ON.
T: the AI plays one turn. Shift+T: the AI plays until
something changes. R, R: the AI plays the full battle.

tips.title: A defeat
lines: You lost the battle, but the career goes on.
To lower the risk: flee or pay tribute when pirates are
much stronger, keep away from sectors with many !, and
buy Clone Insurance. A better ship (Outfitter, Shipyard)
also helps.

tips.title: Your fleet
lines: Each ship has a tab (Left and Right, or click its name).
Up and Down select a module slot or a cargo line.
U uninstalls a module into the fleet hold (one list for all
ships). Enter installs a hold module in an empty slot.
1-8 moves the selected cargo or module to that ship.
F makes a ship the flagship (you command it; no upkeep).
J: the ship joins battles or stays out (safe). Joined ships
use command points: Small 1, Medium 2, Large 3 (at most 6).
N renames a ship.
You can leave when the hold is empty and each ship has an
engine and power. R reverts all module changes.

tips.title: After the battle
lines: Ships with '?' surrendered. P takes one as a prize ship;
C takes its cargo. Ships that you do not take stay behind.
Your fleet has at most 4 ships. X, X scuttles one of your
ships to make room (uninstall its modules first with U).
Esc: done.

tips.title: The Merchants' Guild
lines: The guild posts contracts every 7 days, from real needs.
Supply: deliver goods that a location needs. Each tonne pays
the goods price and a fee, until the need ends (at most
28 days). Freight: carry the guild's cargo (a deposit).
Enter accepts an offer. G shows your contracts.

tips.title: Your contracts
lines: Each contract shows what to do next, the route, and the
reward. Dock at the destination and press D to deliver,
or P to pick up Freight cargo.
A late Freight delivery fails and costs 2 standing.
Bounties pay when done; kill bounties at a Bounty Guild.

tips.title: Your fleet in battle
lines: Your other joined ships fight with the Wingman AI.
O opens the fleet orders: Up/Down selects a ship;
A attacks your target, G guards your ship, H holds
position, R retreats and leaves the battle.
If your ship is lost or flees, you command the next one.
The battle ends when none of your ships is left on the map.
